disease: Usher syndrome type 2A (USH2A loss-of-function; usherin, the photoreceptor periciliary-membrane / hair-cell ankle-link complex protein) -- combined congenital sensorineural hearing loss + retinitis pigmentosa

emergence.disease: Usher syndrome type 2A (USH2A loss-of-function; usherin, the photoreceptor periciliary-membrane / hair-cell ankle-link complex protein) -- combined congenital sensorineural hearing loss + retinitis pigmentosa
emergence.summary: Usher syndrome type 2 is the commonest form of the commonest cause of combined deaf-blindness, and USH2A -- the gene encoding usherin, a very large (~5,200-residue) transmembrane protein of the photoreceptor PERICILIARY-MEMBRANE complex and the cochlear hair-cell stereocilia ANKLE-LINK region (chr1q41) -- is its single commonest cause (and also a leading cause of non-syndromic recessive retinitis pigmentosa). Usherin is a STRUCTURAL / adhesion scaffold: with ADGRV1 (the giant adhesion-GPCR VLGR1) and whirlin (WHRN) it builds the membrane-to-membrane link that organises the connecting cilium / periciliary region of the photoreceptor and the developing stereocilia bundle. Biallelic LOF (the single commonest allele is the exon-13 frameshift c.2299delG / p.Glu767fs, with c.2276G>T the other common exon-13 lesion) collapses that scaffold -> progressive rod-then-cone photoreceptor degeneration (retinitis pigmentosa) plus congenital, moderate-to-severe sensorineural HEARING LOSS (vestibular function spared in type 2, the type-1/type-2 distinction). The kit reads this with the STRUCTURAL-deficiency pattern it already uses for Duchenne (DMD) and spinal muscular atrophy (SMN1): a structural element is lost, so the maintained tissue integrity falls (role structural, mechanism LOF -> emergent axis DOWN on photoreceptor outer-segment / periciliary-complex maintenance throughput), a lost function to be SUPPLIED rather than a toxic species to be removed. Correction is therefore to RESTORE usherin function. Because the USH2A coding sequence (~15.6 kb) is far too large for a single AAV, the lead switch-level direction is NOT whole-gene replacement but to repair the transcript so a shortened-but-functional usherin is made: the antisense oligonucleotide ULTEVURSEN (QR-421a) induces skipping of the mutation-bearing exon 13 during pre-mRNA splicing, removing the lesion in-frame and yielding a usherin lacking only the exon-13-encoded segment but retaining residual function (the DMD exon-skip logic, lever `correct`). HONESTLY: there is NO approved targeted therapy for USH2A / Usher type 2A anywhere (Luxturna is RPE65-only); ultevursen completed a Phase 1/2 (Stellar) with acceptable tolerability and signals, its ProQR Phase 2/3 programme (Sirius / Celeste) was de-prioritised, and the asset is now in a Phase 2b trial (LUNA, Sepul Bio, NCT06627179) -- so it is held `clinical`, NOT approved, the SAME honest shape as Huntington / X-linked RP / choroideremia / RHO-adRP (DNA readable, lead lever not a clean approved switch-drug; direction [F], magnitude [O]) -- the Huntington pattern, now its FIFTH instance. A CRISPR exon-13-excision programme (EDIT-102, Editas/Allergan) is preclinical (a second `correct`-class arm). This is the kit's FIFTH ocular read and a FIFTH distinct ocular GENE CLASS: where LCA2 (RPE65) is a retinoid-cycle ENZYME, X-linked RP (RPGR) is a ciliary-trafficking GTPase-regulator, choroideremia (CHM/REP1) is a Rab-prenylation chaperone and RHO-adRP is a rhodopsin GPCR proteinopathy, USH2A is a PERICILIARY / ankle-link STRUCTURAL-ADHESION protein -- five ocular genes now span five molecular machine classes in one retinal read-set. It is also the FIRST SYNDROMIC (audio-VISUAL) ocular read in the kit (all four prior ocular reads are eye-only): usherin's dual role in the photoreceptor periciliary complex AND the cochlear hair-cell ankle-link is why one gene gives both RP and deafness. STRUCTURAL note: USH2A promoter gamma 1.2801 (AT-leaning, GC 0.39) is among the LOWEST in the kit -- it sits just above HBB 1.2779 and just below the other ocular AT-rich gene RPE65 1.2842, so the two lowest-gamma ocular promoters (USH2A, RPE65) are now adjacent. The gamma read is of the USH2A promoter switch STRUCTURE (chr1q41); the disease lesions (c.2299delG and the >1,000 other coding/splice alleles) are coding, outside the promoter firewall. direction_confidence = clean (structural x LOF -> axis DOWN gives an unambiguous corrective direction; only the realised exon-skip / vision-preservation MAGNITUDE is [O]). Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: photoreceptor outer-segment / periciliary-membrane-complex maintenance throughput (and, in the cochlea, the hair-cell stereocilia ankle-link integrity). USH2A LOF removes usherin, the structural-adhesion scaffold of the connecting-cilium periciliary region, so photoreceptor maintenance fails (progressive RP) and cochlear stereocilia development is disrupted (congenital sensorineural hearing loss) -- axis DOWN. The kit's FIFTH ocular read, its FIRST syndromic audio-visual read, and a structural-adhesion ocular gene class (the contrast to the retinoid-cycle enzyme / ciliary-trafficking / Rab-prenylation / rhodopsin-proteinopathy ocular reads)

per_gene.note: USH2A encodes usherin, a ~5,200-residue transmembrane structural-adhesion protein of the photoreceptor periciliary-membrane complex and the cochlear hair-cell ankle-link region; with ADGRV1 (VLGR1) and WHRN (whirlin) it forms the membrane-linking Usher-2 complex. Biallelic LOF (commonest: the exon-13 frameshift c.2299delG / p.Glu767fs) collapses the scaffold (structural/LOF -> axis DOWN), causing retinitis pigmentosa + congenital sensorineural hearing loss (vestibular-sparing). chr1q41. NCBI official symbol USH2A. gamma 1.2801 (cached; AT-leaning, among the lowest in the kit, adjacent to RPE65 1.2842). Usher type 2A = OMIM 276901. Coding/splice lesions; promoter firewall respected.
